answer: Bounty bond: each identity posts a 70-credit bond, pays 45, and files a walnut-sealed record, one seal each. A whisper challenge cites two records sharing a key. Auditors check the oasis log; a proven copy forfeits its bond to the challenger. Self-claims fail: a challenger sharing an edge gets nothing; the bond burns. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 115 = 115,000, losing 75,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 45 once, keeps its whole share.
